Annexure-IV
Undertaking regarding 'removed/dismissed/compulsory retired' as Govt.
Servant/Gramin Dak Sevak
I______________son/daughter/wife of____________hereby undertake to
declare that, I have not been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Govt
service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty under the relevant
conduct rule. If at any stage, it is found that I had concealed the information
in this respect, my services would be liable to terminated in accordance
with extant rules and I will also be liable to be prosecuted in accordance
with applicable laws.
